# Subway Seat for Rio

Normal, light and dim colours, both cursors, tabs, splits, selection, search and hints. For light/dark following, use `[adaptive-theme]` with `light = "subway-seat-enamel"` and `dark = "subway-seat"`.

[Rio](https://rioterm.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/rio/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | ~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat.toml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | ~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | ~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
